subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the security and CI owners approve these 14 executable action updates for the credentialed, CodeQL, automation, and release workflows after reviewing the codex-action v1.11 runtime changes?
rationale: The diff is mechanically sound, but ordinary tests cannot settle the trust and runtime changes introduced by third-party action code executing with credentials and repository permissions.

options.title: Approve after exact review
options.body: Verify the remaining action SHAs and direct Codex runtime contract, refresh the branch, and merge after security-sensitive exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and mutation-capable automation actions from routine language setup bumps for narrower review.

options.title: Hold existing pins
options.body: Keep the current action commits until security and CI owners can establish the executable dependency contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact review
recommendation.body: Verify the remaining action SHAs and direct Codex runtime contract, refresh the branch, and merge after security-sensitive exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: File history ties this person most strongly to the central CI and Codex-agent workflows, while CODEOWNERS supplies the separate secops approval boundary.
